rules.cardDesc: Set your auto-sync confidence threshold and send a test voice note to verify live synchronization.
rules.conservativeExplanation: Conservative (90%+): Only voice notes with near-certain clarity and complete deal details will update HubSpot automatically. Other notes prompt reps on WhatsApp for quick confirmation.
rules.balancedExplanation: Balanced (Recommended, 80-89%): Voice notes with clear deal stage, amount, or close date sync directly to HubSpot. Ambiguous or low-confidence notes route to reps for one-tap WhatsApp approval.
rules.autonomousExplanation: Autonomous (<80%): Most voice notes update HubSpot directly with minimal confirmation prompts. Recommended for experienced teams.
rules.fallbackPhoneHelp: Sales manager phone that receives review requests if a rep cannot be reached.
rules.invalidFallbackPhone: Fallback phone must be in E.164 format (e.g. +201012345678)
rules.testPromptDesc: Open WhatsApp on your phone and send a voice note to your connected Vexel number. For example:
rules.sampleQuote: “Met with Alpha Corp today, deal value is 50k, moving to Decision Maker Bought-In.”
rules.listeningBadge: Listening for incoming test voice note...
rules.listeningHelp: Vexel will automatically detect your first voice note, transcribe it, and synchronize it to HubSpot.
rules.celebrationDesc: Your first voice note was received and synced to HubSpot. Your sales team can now update deals effortlessly via WhatsApp voice notes.
